packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-21 - unverified image reading (blind first reader)
No identification or prior reading was present in my context. I did nothing beyond the brief's rules.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face 1)
- Two separate paper pieces photographed together on black ground with colour chart and ruler.
- Piece A (left, larger): a sheet folded/opened down the middle (vertical fold near centre, with a red wax seal blob on the fold and a grey redaction/placeholder box beside it). Corners clipped. Text is a vernacular (German) cursive (Kurrent) list of accounting entries, in two blocks: left half and right half, each a single column of entries. Each entry begins with a large looped initial or abbreviation of a forename (e.g. "B:", "H:", "P:", "A:", "L:"), then surname / item and quantity, then a dotted/ruled leader line to an amount at the right ending in "k" / "kr" (kreuzer?) or "fl" signs. Below each block is a total line beginning with a large flourished "Latus"(?) - left "Lat(us) 6 fl 25 kr 3 f(?)", right "Lat(us) 4 fl 45 kr 3 ?". Modern pencil shelfmark at bottom centre: "Stams, STA, Frg. 172-2r."
- Piece B (right, narrow strip): long narrow paper strip, damaged edges and holes, a grey placeholder box at top right. Text in a smaller, more cursive German hand: short headings ("Quatemberlich ...", "Sitterlich"?), entries ending with amounts in fl / kr at right, "Summa" lines in larger letters, closing paragraphs. Modern pencil "Stams, STA, Frg. 172-1r." at bottom.
- No rubrics, no columns of Latin text; this is an account (document), not a book text. Amounts at right margin.
- Tiles image-002..016 are presumably a 5x3 grid of native-resolution tiles over this face (row 1: 002-006, row 2: 007-011, row 3: 012-016). image-017 is the second overview (other face), with tiles 018-032.

=== FACE 1 (overview image-001) ===
Notation: entries begin with large looped forename initials. Line numbers count entries/written lines from top of each tile. Amount column often off-tile to the right.

image-002 (top-left tile; left block of piece A, left half of text column; right side cut off)
002-01  [flourish only, top cut] 
002-02  B: Stangl? 2 roß g[...]          (2nd word: "roß" or "voß"? reading "2 roß"; after it "g" cut)
002-03  H: Gradner? 3 f: Dal[z]            ("f:" abbreviation; last word "Salz"? - letter looks like Kurrent S/D)
002-04  P: Vendemer? 4 ß [...]             ("ß" = abbreviation sign, probably for a measure/unit)
002-05  7 ß Öel ________
002-06  6 ß Prantwein ________
002-07  1 ß Essich? ________               (word: E + ss? + ich; uncertain)
002-08  Von 2 f: Salz? ________            ("Von"/"Ven"? with large loop)
002-09  1 Honig Lagl ________              (Honig with two strokes over o/i; "Lagl" = Lägel?)
002-10  P: Kalchenhamer? 1[...]            (surname uncertain: K/H-al-ch?-en-hamer)
002-11  5 Le: Taak? / Speck? ________      ("Le:" or "Lb:" abbreviation; noun uncertain)
002-12  7 Le: [...]  (cut at bottom)

image-003 (top row, 2nd tile; right half of left block with amount column; overlaps 002 on left). A vertical ruled line separates amount from unit sign. Unit sign after numbers is a "k"-like sign with long tail, read as kr (kreuzer?) - written "k" below. Lines aligned to entries of 002:
003-01  [top, cut] .... 3 fl? / "3 k"?  (only end of heading entry visible)
003-02  [Stangl?] 2 roß gl ________ .... 32 k        (so 002-02 ends "2 roß gl" / "roßgl")
003-03  3 f: Salz? ________ .... 9 k
003-04  [Vende]mer 4 ß Reiß ________ .... 48 k       ("Reiß" = rice? clear R-e-i-ß)
003-05  [7 ß Öel] ________ .... 24 k
003-06  [Prant]wein ________ [hole] 4 k                (leading digit lost in hole? reads "..4")
003-07  [Essich] ________ .... 3 k
003-08  [Von 2 f:] Salz ________ .... 6 k
003-09  [Honig La]gl ________ .... 6 k
003-10  [Kalchen?]hamer 10 Le: Pley ________ .... 30 k  ("10 Lb:? Pley" = Blei?; "Le:" abbrev. same as 002-11)
003-11  [5 Le: ...]l ________ .... 13 k 3 f?           (after "13 k" a second sign: "3" + f-like sign, perhaps pfennig/vierer)
003-12  [7 Le: ...]l (cut)

image-004 (top row, 3rd tile; centre fold at left, grey placeholder box over fold area; start of RIGHT block of piece A; right side cut). Faint offset/mirror writing visible near the box (show-through, not read).
004-01  M(?)arthei? Prandtner? vnd sein ge-     (first word with big looped initial: "Marthei"/"Matheis"?; 2nd "Prandtner"/"Pranndtner")
004-02  sſan? 10 ß Brein ________              (line 2 continues: "...ssan"/"ſſan" then "10 ß Brein"; "Brein" clear B-r-e-i-n)
004-03  Von 2 Troth? Salz h[...]                (word after 2: "Troth"/"Tröch"? uncertain; then "Salz"; "h" = start of next word, see 005)
004-04  Ch: Klingenbach? vnd sein [...]         ("Ch:"/"Ꝯ:" initial uncertain; surname "Klingenbach"/"Klingentaal"?)
004-05  Von? 16 ß Brein ________                (continuation line; first word with loop - "Von"/"tern"?)
004-06  H: Weingarla? 10 ß Br[ein]
004-07  B: Trautmair 7 [...]                    ("7" followed by word with "ß"/"yßh"?, cut)
004-08  Sb:/St: Ploygerla? vnd sein g[es...]
004-09  18 ß Brein ________
004-10  Her? 1 ß Reiß ________                  (first word "Her"/"Hev" with loop; "Reiß" as 003-04)
004-11  [cut] A: Ka[...]  (bottom)

image-005 (top row, 4th tile; right half of right block with amounts, then black ground, then left edge of strip B). Overlaps 004.
005-01  [Pr]anndtner vnd sein ge-               (so 004-01 = "... Pranndtner vnd sein ge-")
005-02  [...]ein ________                       (= 004-02 "...10 ß Brein"; amount not visible on this tile - line ends at edge)
005-03  [Trot]h? Salz hinaus ________ ......    (amount column empty/cut at sheet edge)
005-04  [Klingen]taal? vnd sein ges pan        ("gespan"? written "ges" + "pan" with odd join)
005-05  [16 ß Br]ein ________ .... 48 [k]
005-06  [Weingar]la 10 ß Brein ________ .... 30 k
005-07  [Trautma]ir 7 yhen?/Yhren? Kraut ________ .... [hole]3 k   ("Kraut" fairly clear; preceding word uncertain)
005-08  [Ploygerla] vnd sein ges Pandlen?      (last word "Pandlen"/"Kandlen"? uncertain)
005-09  [18 ß Brein] ________ .... 54 k
005-10  [Her? 1 ß Rei]ß ________ .... 6 k
Strip B left edge, top: only first letters visible; read from tiles 006 etc.

image-006 (top row, 5th tile; strip B, upper part; grey placeholder box upper right). Smaller, more cursive hand; amounts at right in "fl" (looped f with cross-stroke) and "k".
006-01  [...]e? Erb? [...]ar[...]                  (top edge damaged; mostly illegible)
006-02  [..]dlin?-Stellige? Schind. [...]           (uncertain; "Schind." or "Schuld."?)
006-03  genannt
006-04  (blank)
006-05  Quatemberlich Gült.                         (centered heading; "Qu..." = Quatember?; "Gült"/"Gilt")
006-06  Laplich? in lebelandig? / [...]            (first word with loop "La-/Ka-plich"?; uncertain)
006-07  [..] Leonhart. ________ 5 fl 2 k           (name underlined-ish; marginal letters at far left "[..]" cut)
006-08  (blank)
006-09  Sitterlich? / Döitterlich?                  (centered heading; uncertain)
006-10  Jn ligenden vnnd
006-11  farenden sein dritten?                       ("dritten"/"deutten"?)
006-12  tail ________ 76 fl 52 k?                   (read "76 fl 5 2 k"; could be 5 and 2 = 52 kr)
006-13  Ch? vmb ain Von Jrem                         (first word looped "Ch"/"Ist"?)
006-14  Vorhaben? hering? zu                         (uncertain)
006-15  Neugkhofen? verkaufft?                       ("Neugkhofen"/"Pergkhofen"? ; "verkaufft" with superscript e/u)
006-16  Roß? / yelh? - - - - - - . 2 fl 30 k         (first word uncertain)
006-17  Summa [cut]

image-007 (middle row, 1st tile; lower part of LEFT block, left half; overlaps 002 at top - lines 1-2 repeat 002-10/11). Then blank and flourish of the total line.
007-01  P: Kalchenhamer? 1[0 ...]               (= 002-10)
007-02  5 Lb:? Taak?/Tnak? ________             (= 002-11; noun still uncertain, initial like T/P with loop)
007-03  7 Lb:? Nagl ________                    (002-12; "Nagl" = nails?; N-a-g-l fairly clear)
007-04  H: Dündl?/Lindl? vnd gespan 1[1 ...]   ("vnd gespan" as in right block)
007-05  A: Wachmoser?/Rackenoser? 7 Rß [...]     (surname uncertain; "Rß"/"Uß" abbrev.)
007-06  2 Ochsenhut?/Ozenheit? ________         (word uncertain: O + z/ch + en + h + ut/eit)
007-07  2 f: Salz ________
007-08  W: Valentin 10 ß Sa[lz]
(below: blank; large flourished stroke = beginning of total line "Lat(us)" shown on overview)

image-008 (middle row, 2nd tile; amount column of lower LEFT block; overlaps 003 at top; red wax seal on fold at right).
008-01  [..ha]mer 10 Lb:? Pley ________ .... 30 k      (= 003-10)
008-02  [...]l ________ .... 13 k 3 f?                  (= 003-11; second unit after "3" a looped sign different from "k" - perhaps "f"/vierer or "₰")
008-03  [Nag]l ________ .... 2 k
008-04  [vnd] gespan 11 f: Salz ________ .... 33 k
008-05  [...]er 7 Rß gl: ________ 1 fl 24 k            ("gl:" as in 003-02 "roß gl"; amount "i ff 24 k" = 1 fl 24 kr)
008-06  [2 Ochsenhut?] ________ .... 2 k
008-07  [2 f: Salz] ________ .... 6 k
008-08  [Valent]in 10 ß Salz ________ .... 30 k
(below: blank; part of total flourish)
NOTE: the unit sign I write "k" has a "k/kr" ductus with a long sweeping tail; "fl" written as looped double-f with crossbar.
Also note: 002-02/003-02 "2 roß gl" and 008-05 "7 Rß gl" - same item abbreviation, so 002-02 may be "2 Rß gl" rather than "roß".

image-009 (middle row, 3rd tile; lower RIGHT block, left half; wax seal at left on fold; overlaps 004 at top).
009-01  18 ß Brein ________                    (= 004-09)
009-02  Her? 1 ß Reiß ________                 (= 004-10; a stray "L"-like stroke below "1")
009-03  A: Keichl?/Reichl? vnd gespan
009-04  L: Windl? vnd sein ges[pan]           ("Windl"/"Mindl")
009-05  Salz ________

=== SUMMARY / LIMITATIONS ===
- All 32 images viewed; every written line on both faces was attempted. No image-limit stop.
- Content observed: two paper documents in a 16th/17th-c.-type German Kurrent hand(s) (no dating inferred). Piece A (both faces): a list of named persons (forename initial + surname) with quantities of goods - Salz (in "f:" units and "ß" units), Brein, Reiß, Prantwein, Öel, Essich?, Honig Lagl, Nagl, Pley, Kraut/Khraut ("7 ÿhren? Kraut"), "roß gl"/"Rß gl", "ÿhren? wein", "Salz stokh" - with prices in kr (and a second minor unit written as small digit + looped sign, here "f?") and page totals "Lat(us)": face 1 left 6 fl 25 k 3 f?, face 1 right 4 fl 45 k 3 f?, face 2 left 1 fl 37 k 3 f?, face 2 right 11 fl 38 k 1 f?. Recurring formula "vnd sein(e) gespan" / "gespandlen?". Piece B (recto only; verso blank): a settlement/account in a different, more cursive hand: headings "Quatemberlich Gült", "Sitterlich?", entries "Jn ligenden vnnd farenden sein dritten tail 76 fl 52? k", "Summa 84 fl 38? k", deductions, "Summa 4 fl 38 k", "Bleibt Jr noch schuldig 80 fl 6 k", interest "von Liechtmeß ... 78 biß auf Liechtmeß ... 79 ... 3 fl 15 k", "dem Khind ... sein drittail".
- Uncertain throughout: most surnames; the unit abbreviations "ß", "f:", "Lb:/Le:", the second minor-currency sign; several words on strip B (marked "?").
- Damage: holes on strip B obscure 011-08/09 and the start of 016-03, 016-12..15; top edge of piece A face 2 trims the first line (018-01, 020-01, 021-01). Grey placeholder boxes cover the fold area (face 1) and parts of strip B (both faces); a little text may lie under the strip-B box on face 1 (top right, near 006-01..03).
